outputs.explanation: Panel A is a photograph of dissected intestines, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
Panel B shows H&E-stained micrographs, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.

The upper box plot (total polyp number per genotype) already displays the distribution and is exempt. However, the lower 3D bar chart shows mean polyp numbers per diameter bin per genotype (n=8-18 mice) without overlaying the individual per-mouse data points, so the requirement is not met for this bar chart.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival line plot, which is exempt from the individual data points requirement.
The bar graph quantifying relative GTP-bound Rac1 and Cdc42 shows only mean bars with error bars, with no individual data points overlaid.
Panel F shows immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
The bar graph of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) displays only mean bars with error bars and significance asterisks, without individual data points shown.
